method: All 188 saved Japanese paragraphs reread side by side against Chinese after completing the three essays. Title and deck were also checked. Chinese series index description translated directly, not from its abridged English counterpart.

findings.result: Preserved all five regime steps and examples, original ignorance rather than bad will, constitutional compromise, accumulating unreviewed assumptions, democracy as both remedy and risk, and the unanswered institutional question. Rephrased no longer brought out for inspection to avoid implying inspection has become impossible.

Preserved numbered lottery versus chosen life, all named mythic choosers, three sisters, measured drinking and Er not drinking, three layers of difference, conditional Glaucus image, and Odysseus deliberately seeking an ordinary life. Replaced an unwarranted idiom of agreeing readily with without hesitation, clarified made by others, smoothed the plural life-pattern example, and removed a double-negative ambiguity in the reverse question about what the lack is relative to.

Preserved soothing versus answering, internal currency of proof, three thin shared grounds, local gains without promised convergence, the measuring-reader objection, and descent as textual fact without claiming authorial intent. Changed must not make into cannot make when referring to one framework furnishing the other with foundations.

Both original Chinese series-desc paragraphs translated, including shared local comparison, all thirteen-essay topics, three reading moves, and rejection of annexation or certification. Source note accurately describes full Chinese translation.

limits: No independent Greek-original verification. Chinese claims and open objections are retained rather than silently repaired.
